name: mousetrail
blurb: Images follow cursor with spacing, appearing and fading as mouse moves.
description: Renders images that appear near the cursor when moving. Images space themselves based on cursor distance and optionally fade after a delay.
use_when: Interactive galleries or playful hover experiences where mouse movement reveals image previews.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces — cursor tracking requires a mouse pointer.
a11y: Images lack alt text and semantic labeling. Visual effect only; no keyboard interaction.
